scope: Lean model statements only (MC1 model, Mathlib oracle, transcribed literal accumulator and runtime helpers, plus the pinned NamedV1 normal-return linking and operand/continuation ABI model). No implementation theorem.
mathlib_oleans: downloaded Lake cache (lake exe cache get), not rebuilt: separate trust assumption

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofZ
theorems.claim: ofZ then toZ is the identity on ZMod (2^64)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofZ : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), NobleFoundation.toZ (NobleFoundation.ofZ r) = r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_toZ
theorems.claim: toZ then ofZ is the identity on BitVec 64
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_toZ : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.ofZ (NobleFoundation.toZ x) = x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_injective
theorems.claim: toZ is injective
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_injective : Function.Injective NobleFoundation.toZ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_injective
theorems.claim: ofZ is injective
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_injective : Function.Injective NobleFoundation.ofZ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofInt
theorems.claim: toZ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n) = (n : ZMod (2^64))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofInt : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.toZ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n) = ↑n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_intCast
theorems.claim: ofZ (n : ZMod (2^64)) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_intCast : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.ofZ ↑n = BitVec.ofInt 64 n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_add
theorems.claim: toZ is additive
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_add : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a + b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a + NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_mul
theorems.claim: toZ is multiplicative
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_mul : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a * b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a * NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_sub
theorems.claim: toZ preserves subtraction
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_sub : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a - b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a - NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_neg
theorems.claim: toZ preserves negation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_neg : ∀ (a : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (-a) = -NobleFoundation.toZ a

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_bmod
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap n = Int.bmod n (2^64)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_bmod : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap n = n.bmod (2 ^ 64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_toInt_ofInt
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap n = (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_toInt_ofInt : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap n = (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_knum01
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap z = ((z + 2^63) mod 2^64) - 2^63 (K-NUM-01 formula)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_knum01 : ∀ (z : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap z = (z + 2 ^ 63) % 2 ^ 64 - 2 ^ 63

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_eq_toInt
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.signed r = (ofZ r).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_eq_toInt : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), MathlibI64.signed r = (NobleFoundation.ofZ r).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_toZ
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.signed (toZ x) = x.toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_toZ : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), MathlibI64.signed (NobleFoundation.toZ x) = x.toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_range
theorems.claim: every BitVec 64 decodes into [-2^63, 2^63)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_range : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.I64Range x.toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_range
theorems.claim: every residue decodes into [-2^63, 2^63)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_range : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), NobleFoundation.I64Range (MathlibI64.signed r)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.intCast_toInt
theorems.claim: ((x.toInt : ℤ) : ZMod (2^64)) = toZ x
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.intCast_toInt : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), ↑x.toInt = NobleFoundation.toZ x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.intCast_signed
theorems.claim: residue -> signed integer -> residue is the identity
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.intCast_signed : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), ↑(MathlibI64.signed r) = r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_of_range
theorems.claim: integer -> BitVec -> integer is the identity on the I64 range
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_of_range : ∀ {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.I64Range n → (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_eq_iff
theorems.claim: (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n iff n is in the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_eq_iff : ∀ (n : ℤ), (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n ↔ NobleFoundation.I64Range n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_intCast_eq_iff
theorems.claim: signed (n : ZMod (2^64)) = n iff n is in the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_intCast_eq_iff : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.signed ↑n = n ↔ NobleFoundation.I64Range n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_toInt
theorems.claim: BitVec -> integer -> BitVec is the identity
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_toInt : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), BitVec.ofInt 64 x.toInt = x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_wrap
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt 64 (wrap n) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_wrap : ∀ (n : ℤ), BitVec.ofInt 64 (MathlibI64.wrap n) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_sub
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt 64 (x - y) = ofInt x - ofInt y
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_sub : ∀ (x y : ℤ), BitVec.ofInt 64 (x - y) = BitVec.ofInt 64 x - BitVec.ofInt 64 y

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_add
theorems.claim: (a + b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_add : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a + b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_sub
theorems.claim: (a - b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_sub : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a - b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_mul
theorems.claim: (a * b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_mul : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a * b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_add
theorems.claim: wrap (x + y) = (ofInt x + ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_add : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x + y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x + BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_sub
theorems.claim: wrap (x - y) = (ofInt x - ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_sub : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x - y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x - BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_mul
theorems.claim: wrap (x * y) = (ofInt x * ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_mul : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x * y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x * BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral
theorems.claim: the transcribed checked i64 digit accumulator accepts exactly the in-range literals, unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral : ∀ (negative : Bool) (ds : List (Fin 10)), NobleFoundation.accumulate negative ds = NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.accepted_literal_exact
theorems.claim: an accepted literal is in range and decodes without wrapping
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.accepted_literal_exact : ∀ {negative : Bool} {ds : List (Fin 10)} {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds = some n → NobleFoundation.I64Range n ∧ n = NobleFoundation.literalValue negative ds ∧ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral_eq_none_iff
theorems.claim: a literal is rejected iff its value is outside the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral_eq_none_iff : ∀ (negative : Bool) (ds : List (Fin 10)), NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds = none ↔ ¬NobleFoundation.I64Range (NobleFoundation.literalValue negative ds)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_collapses_out_of_range
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt identifies 2^63 with -2^63; only the latter is an accepted literal
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_collapses_out_of_range : BitVec.ofInt 64 (2 ^ 63) = BitVec.ofInt 64 (-2 ^ 63) ∧ 2 ^ 63 ≠ -2 ^ 63 ∧ ¬NobleFoundation.I64Range (2 ^ 63) ∧ NobleFoundation.I64Range (-2 ^ 63)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.literal_range_iff_no_wrap
theorems.claim: I64Range n iff BitVec.ofInt 64 n decodes to n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.literal_range_iff_no_wrap : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.I64Range n ↔ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.literal_boundary_regressions
theorems.claim: accumulator: 2^63 rejected; -2^63, 2^63-1, -(2^63-1), -0 accepted; -(2^63+1) rejected
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.literal_boundary_regressions : NobleFoundation.accumulate false NobleFoundation.digitsTwoPow63 = none ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true NobleFoundation.digitsTwoPow63 = some (-9223372036854775808) ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate false NobleFoundation.digitsMax = some 9223372036854775807 ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true NobleFoundation.digitsMax = some (-9223372036854775807) ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true [0] = some 0 ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true [9, 2, 2, 3, 3, 7, 2, 0, 3, 6, 8, 5, 4, 7, 7, 5, 8, 0, 9] = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_iff
theorems.claim: Represents v n iff v = .i64 x with x.toInt = n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.represents_iff : ∀ (v : NobleContracts.Value) (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.Represents v n ↔ ∃ x, v = NobleContracts.Value.i64 x ∧ x.toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_functional
theorems.claim: an I64 value represents at most one integer
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.represents_functional : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} {n m : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.Represents v n → NobleFoundation.Represents v m → n = m

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_of_hasType
theorems.claim: every well-typed I64 value represents its toInt
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.represents_of_hasType : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} (h : NobleContracts.HasType v NobleContracts.Ty.i64), NobleFoundation.Represents v (match v, h with | NobleContracts.Value.i64 x, h => x.toInt | x, h => 0)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.hasType_of_represents
theorems.claim: represented values are typed I64
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.hasType_of_represents : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.Represents v n → NobleContracts.HasType v NobleContracts.Ty.i64

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_wrap
theorems.claim: i64v (wrap z) represents wrap z
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.represents_wrap : ∀ (z : ℤ), NobleFoundation.Represents (NobleFoundation.i64v (MathlibI64.wrap z)) (MathlibI64.wrap z)

theorems.name: NobleContracts.StackTyped.append
theorems.claim: StackTyped is closed under public-orientation concatenation
theorems.statement: @NobleContracts.StackTyped.append : ∀ {s t : NobleContracts.Stack} {ts tt : List NobleContracts.Ty}, NobleContracts.StackTyped s ts → NobleContracts.StackTyped t tt → NobleContracts.StackTyped (s ++ t) (ts ++ tt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.stackTyped_snoc_i64
theorems.claim: pushing an I64 extends the typed public stack
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.stackTyped_snoc_i64 : ∀ {s : NobleContracts.Stack} {ts : List NobleContracts.Ty}, NobleContracts.StackTyped s ts → ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleContracts.StackTyped (s ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v n]) (ts ++ [NobleContracts.Ty.i64])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.internal_of_public
theorems.claim: public pre ++ [a, b] is internal b :: a :: reverse pre
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.internal_of_public : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : NobleContracts.Value), List.reverse (pre ++ [a, b]) = b :: a :: List.reverse pre

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_sub_is_internal_step
theorems.claim: public subtraction is internal Step.sub with the public top as subtrahend
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_sub_is_internal_step : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 5] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ NobleContracts.Step (NobleContracts.Op.word 5) (NobleContracts.Value.i64 b :: NobleContracts.Value.i64 a :: List.reverse pre) (List.reverse t)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 4 (+): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x + y))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 4 fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.sub_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 5 (-): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x - y)), x deeper
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.sub_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 5 fun x1 x2 => x1 - x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.mul_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 6 (*): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x * y))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.mul_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 6 fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_arith_toInt
theorems.claim: for arbitrary BitVec operands the add/sub/mul result decodes to wrap of decoded operands
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_arith_toInt : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 5] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 6] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt))

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_needs_i64
theorems.claim: add has no normal transition when either operand is not I64
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_needs_i64 : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), ¬NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ∧ ¬NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 b, NobleContracts.Value.bool true]) t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.refRun_append
theorems.claim: reference machine sequencing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.refRun_append : ∀ (a b : List NobleFoundation.AOp) (zs : List ℤ), NobleFoundation.refRun (a ++ b) zs = (NobleFoundation.refRun a zs).bind (NobleFoundation.refRun b)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.depthRun_append
theorems.claim: static depth sequencing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.depthRun_append : ∀ (a b : List NobleFoundation.AOp) (k : ℕ), NobleFoundation.depthRun (a ++ b) k = (NobleFoundation.depthRun a k).bind (NobleFoundation.depthRun b)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.run_lowerAll
theorems.claim: internal-orientation simulation of lowered sequences by the reference machine
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.run_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → ∀ (r t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Run (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (List.map NobleFoundation.i64v zs ++ r) t ↔ t = List.map NobleFoundation.i64v zs' ++ r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll
theorems.claim: public lifting: any prefix, unique normal result pre ++ enc (reference result)
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.refRun_range
theorems.claim: reference stacks stay in the I64 range
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.refRun_range : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → (∀ z ∈ zs, NobleFoundation.I64Range z) → ∀ z ∈ zs', NobleFoundation.I64Range z

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.depthRun_of_refRun
theorems.claim: reference success implies the static depth check
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.depthRun_of_refRun : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → NobleFoundation.depthRun ops zs.length = some zs'.length

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.codeTyped_lowerAll
theorems.claim: depth check implies CodeTyped from base ++ k*I64 to base ++ k'*I64
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.codeTyped_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun ops k = some k' → ∀ (base : List NobleContracts.Ty), NobleContracts.CodeTyped (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.body_eq
theorems.claim: composed body is the lowering of the flattened sequence
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.body_eq : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr), P.body = NobleFoundation.lowerAll P.flat

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code
theorems.claim: construction pushes exactly one program value and executes nothing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec P.code s t ↔ t = s ++ [NobleContracts.Value.program P.body]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_run
theorems.claim: construct then run = execute the composed body
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_run : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) s t ↔ NobleContracts.Exec P.body s t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_reflect
theorems.claim: reflect observes exactly the composed recipe
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_reflect : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 11]) s t ↔ t = s ++ [NobleContracts.Value.syntax P.body]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref
theorems.claim: quote/block/compose/run equals the reference machine with any preserved prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun P.flat zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped
theorems.claim: construction code is CodeTyped on any stack type
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (S base : List NobleContracts.Ty) {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun P.flat k = some k' → NobleContracts.CodeTyped P.code S (S ++ [NobleContracts.Ty.program (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped_run
theorems.claim: construct-then-run is CodeTyped with the whole-stack input premise
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped_run : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (base : List NobleContracts.Ty) {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun P.flat k = some k' → NobleContracts.CodeTyped (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_quote_program_run_run
theorems.claim: nested quotation: quote a program, run twice = run it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_quote_program_run_run : ∀ (p : List NobleContracts.Op) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.block p, NobleContracts.Op.word 8, NobleContracts.Op.word 10, NobleContracts.Op.word 10] s t ↔ NobleContracts.Exec p s t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_boundaries
theorems.claim: signed min/max, zero and negative oracle boundaries

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.sub_operand_order
theorems.claim: 3 8 - is -5, 8 3 - is 5, and they differ
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.sub_operand_order : ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 3, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 8, NobleFoundation.AOp.sub]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v (-5)]) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 8, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 3, NobleFoundation.AOp.sub]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 5]) ∧ NobleFoundation.i64v (-5) ≠ NobleFoundation.i64v 5

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_max_wraps_preserving_prefix
theorems.claim: max + 1 wraps to min above a non-I64 prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_max_wraps_preserving_prefix : ∀ (t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775807, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add]) [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.text "kept"] t ↔ t = [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.text "kept", NobleFoundation.i64v (-9223372036854775808)]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.out_of_range_push_refused
theorems.claim: reference refuses push 2^63 although MC1 lowering would alias it to -2^63
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.out_of_range_push_refused : NobleFoundation.refRun [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775808] [] = none ∧ (NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775808).lower = (NobleFoundation.AOp.push (-9223372036854775808)).lower

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.quote_compose_run_examples
theorems.claim: 5 quote [1 +] compose run = 6; max quote [1 +] compose run = min
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.quote_compose_run_examples : ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.quoted 5).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 6]) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.quoted 9223372036854775807).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v (-9223372036854775808)])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.compose_order_matters
theorems.claim: [2 *][1 +] compose and reverse differ on 5

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.takeName_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (tag : ℕ), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.takeName (name ++ [34, 32, 35, tag, 62]) = some (name, [32, 35, tag, 62])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService_encode
theorems.claim: the closed-schema parser recognizes the canonical encoding of an acquired value
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready) = some (name, ready)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode_encode
theorems.claim: a value round-trips: for an acquired name and configured depth, decoding the canonical encoding yields that value
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool) (configuredDepth : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName name = true → 1 ≤ configuredDepth ∧ configuredDepth ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready) configuredDepth = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted name ready

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_of_accepted
theorems.claim: an accepted byte sequence is exactly the canonical encoding of the value it decodes to
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_of_accepted : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (configuredDepth : ℕ) (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configuredDepth = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted name ready → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready = bytes

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_fits_wire_budget
theorems.claim: the longest acquired name still fits the 64-byte wire budget
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_fits_wire_budget : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName name = true → (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready).length ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireBytes

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.byte_limit_precedes_depth_scan
theorems.claim: the byte budget is decided before the depth scan
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.byte_limit_precedes_depth_scan : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (List.replicate 65 60) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.byteLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_configuration_precedes_schema
theorems.claim: an unacquired configured depth rejects a well-formed record as a depth failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_configuration_precedes_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true) 0 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true) 5 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_scan_precedes_schema
theorems.claim: the bracket count is decided before the schema match
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_scan_precedes_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 34, 120, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62, 62, 62, 62, 62] 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.altered_readiness_is_schema
theorems.claim: a readiness tag other than #t or #f is a schema failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.altered_readiness_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 34, 99, 108, 111, 99, 107, 34, 32, 35, 120, 62] 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.trailing_bytes_are_schema
theorems.claim: trailing bytes are rejected, so the decoder is a document decoder and not a prefix decoder
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.trailing_bytes_are_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true ++ [98]) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.empty_name_is_schema
theorems.claim: an empty name is rejected although the rest of the record is well formed
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.empty_name_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 34, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62] 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.foreign_name_byte_is_schema
theorems.claim: a name byte outside the acquired alphabet is rejected, which is the model form of the non-ASCII and wrong-alphabet rejections
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.foreign_name_byte_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 34, 99, 255, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62] 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_is_rejected
theorems.claim: a 33-byte name exceeds the name budget
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_is_rejected : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName (List.replicate 33 97) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_round_trips
theorems.claim: the longest acquired name round-trips, which is the name bound exact accepting edge
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_round_trips : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode (List.replicate 32 97) false) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted (List.replicate 32 97) false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.shortest_name_round_trips
theorems.claim: the shortest acquired name round-trips
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.shortest_name_round_trips : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [97] true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted [97] true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordPrefix
theorems.claim: the record prefix opens one bracket and closes none, so the balanced scan reaches depth one
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordPrefix : ∀ (rest : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 0 0 (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ rest) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 1 1 rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_of_plain
theorems.claim: a name byte is neither an opener nor a closer, so a name drawn from the admitted alphabet leaves the scan unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_of_plain : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (current reached : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached (name ++ rest) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordSuffix
theorems.claim: the record suffix closes the prefix's bracket and opens none, so the scan reaches at most depth one
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordSuffix : ∀ (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 1 1 (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready) = 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.unbalanced_closers_do_not_count_toward_the_depth
theorems.claim: an input with stray openers and a closing byte below zero depth is a schema failure at depth two, not a depth failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.unbalanced_closers_do_not_count_toward_the_depth : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 32, 34, 60, 97, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62, 60] 2 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable_iff
theorems.claim: a payload is duplicable exactly when no resource occurs at any depth
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable_iff : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true ↔ NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource payload = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.data_duplicable
theorems.claim: every data payload is duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.data_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data tag) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: a must-use resource payload is never duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_duplicable
theorems.claim: wrapping a payload never changes its eligibility, so eligibility is recursive
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_duplicable : ∀ (inner : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable inner.wrapped = NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable inner

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_data_duplicable
theorems.claim: a wrapped data payload is duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_data_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data tag).wrapped = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: a wrapped resource payload is not duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag).wrapped = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_preserves_eligibility
theorems.claim: eligibility is unchanged at every wrapping depth
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_preserves_eligibility : ∀ (depth : ℕ) (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth depth payload) = NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: no wrapping depth makes a resource payload duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (depth tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth depth (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag)) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_operand_blocks_every_word
theorems.claim: a must-use resource as the constrained operand blocks every word of the fragment
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_operand_blocks_every_word : ∀ (word : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word) (tag : ℕ) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.step word (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag :: rest) = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.drop_consumes_one
theorems.claim: dropping consumes exactly the duplicable operand it inspected and no must-use obligation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.drop_consumes_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.drop (payload :: rest) = some rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.dup_duplicates_one
theorems.claim: duplication preserves both copies of the duplicable operand
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.dup_duplicates_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.dup (payload :: rest) = some (payload :: payload :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.quote_retains_one
theorems.claim: quoting retains the obligation it inspected rather than consuming it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.quote_retains_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.quote (payload :: rest) = some (payload :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_permutes_two
theorems.claim: swapping permutes two duplicable operands and consumes neither
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_permutes_two : ∀ (left right : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable left = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable right = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.swap (left :: right :: rest) = some (right :: left :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.run_sound
theorems.claim: checker acceptance implies the declarative accounting judgment
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.run_sound : ∀ (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.run program operands = some out → NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts program operands out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.branch_accounts_both_arms
theorems.claim: a two-arm branch accounts for the same obligations on both arms
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.branch_accounts_both_arms : ∀ (thenArm elseArm : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (start out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts (thenArm.branch elseArm) start out → NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts thenArm start out ∧ NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts elseArm start out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_requires_empty_operands
theorems.claim: a normal error return is acquired only with no outstanding operand
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_requires_empty_operands : ∀ (start out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.fail start out → start = [] ∧ out = []

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_rejects_outstanding_operand
theorems.claim: an outstanding operand is never abandoned by the error-return alternative
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_rejects_outstanding_operand : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.run NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.fail (payload :: rest) = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.segment_conserved
theorems.claim: the opaque segment and its must-use obligations are conserved by every acquired program
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.segment_conserved : ∀ (segment : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.runConfiguration segment program operands = some (segment, out) → NobleFoundation.Ownership.run program operands = some out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_preserves_other_keys
theorems.claim: one single-slot publication leaves every other slot selection unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_preserves_other_keys : ∀ (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (key other generation : ℕ), key ≠ other → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish entries key generation) other = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select entries other

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_selects_the_published_generation
theorems.claim: one single-slot publication selects exactly the published generation for its own slot
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_selects_the_published_generation : ∀ (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (key generation : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish entries key generation) key = some generation

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pin_is_immutable
theorems.claim: pinning stores the published map and nothing replaces it in place
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pin_is_immutable : ∀ (epoch : ℕ) (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap), (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinRoot epoch entries).pinned = entries

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.root_selections_use_pinned_map
theorems.claim: every live selection a root makes comes from its own pinned map
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.root_selections_use_pinned_map : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (requests : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root requests = List.filterMap (fun key => match NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select root.pinned key with | some generation => some (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.GuestEvent.dispatch root.epoch key generation) | none => none) requests

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.frozen_entry_map_reference_agrees
theorems.claim: execution through a root equals the frozen-entry-map reference for the same requests
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.frozen_entry_map_reference_agrees : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (requests : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root requests = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reference root.epoch root.pinned requests

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixed_map_selects_old_and_new
theorems.claim: two separate single-slot publications are not one atomic replacement, so a map pinned between them selects a mixed pair
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixed_map_selects_old_and_new : ∀ (fresh : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixedMap fresh) 0 = some 2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denied_dispatch_produces_no_guest_event
theorems.claim: a denied dispatch stops execution before producing a guest event
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denied_dispatch_produces_no_guest_event : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (key : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorize false root key = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorized_dispatch_selects_the_pinned_generation
theorems.claim: an authorized dispatch selects the generation its pinned map names
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorized_dispatch_selects_the_pinned_generation : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (key generation : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select root.pinned key = some generation → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorize true root key = some (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.GuestEvent.dispatch root.epoch key generation)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormal_prefix_preserves_committed_events
theorems.claim: a finite abnormal prefix keeps the committed guest events
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormal_prefix_preserves_committed_events : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (before : List ℕ) (deniedKey : ℕ), (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormalPrefix root before deniedKey).1 = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root before

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_same
theorems.claim: Charging a matching checkpoint entry adds its cost to that checkpoint total.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_same : ∀ (checkpoint : ℕ) (charges : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cost : ℕ), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ((checkpoint, cost) :: charges) = cost + NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint charges

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_other
theorems.claim: Charging a different checkpoint leaves this checkpoint total unchanged.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_other : ∀ (checkpoint other : ℕ) (charges : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cost : ℕ), other ≠ checkpoint → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ((other, cost) :: charges) = NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint charges

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_alignment
theorems.claim: The initial ledger has aligned consumed witnesses and registered attempts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_alignment : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_uniqueness
theorems.claim: The initial ledger consumes no witness twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_uniqueness : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_within_quota
theorems.claim: The initial ledger charges nothing, so it is within any snapshot.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_within_quota : ∀ (snapshot : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Snapshot), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial snapshot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_started_at_most_once
theorems.claim: The initial ledger registers no attempt, so at-most-once starts holds.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_started_at_most_once : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.StartedAtMostOnce NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refused_request_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: A refusal leaves the ledger definitionally unchanged; only separate counters move.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refused_request_preserves_ledger : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refuse ledger facts = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.denied_admission_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: Accepting an already consumed witness refuses and preserves the ledger.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.denied_admission_preserves_ledger : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∈ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_consumes_exactly_one_witness
theorems.claim: A fresh witness under admissible facts adds exactly that witness to the consumed set.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_consumes_exactly_one_witness : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint).consumed = witness :: ledger.consumed

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_registers_one_attempt
theorems.claim: The same step registers exactly one not-yet-started attempt.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_registers_one_attempt : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint).attempts = { witness := witness, checkpoint := checkpoint, cost := facts.cost, started := false } :: ledger.attempts

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.altered_plan_cannot_mint
theorems.claim: An altered requested plan fails exact equality and mints nothing.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.altered_plan_cannot_mint : ∀ (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ) (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.plan ≠ facts.requestedPlan → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.stale_facts_cannot_mint
theorems.claim: Revoked, invalid-checkpoint, stale-policy or unauthenticated facts mint nothing.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.stale_facts_cannot_mint : ∀ (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ) (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.revoked = true ∨ facts.checkpointValid = false ∨ facts.policyLive = false ∨ facts.sourceAuthentic = false → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_is_consumption
theorems.claim: A fresh admissible request reaches the consuming transition.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_is_consumption : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.consume ledger facts witness checkpoint

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_alignment
theorems.claim: One admission keeps consumed witnesses aligned with registered attempts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_alignment : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_uniqueness
theorems.claim: One admission keeps no witness consumed twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_uniqueness : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_quota
theorems.claim: One admission keeps checkpoint charges within the supplied snapshot when the acquired cost fits.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_quota : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (snapshot : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Snapshot) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota ledger snapshot → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ledger.charges + facts.cost ≤ snapshot checkpoint → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint) snapshot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.started_attempt_cannot_start_again
theorems.claim: Starting an already started attempt is refused rather than counted twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.started_attempt_cannot_start_again : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (attempt : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Attempt), List.find? (fun other => decide (other.witness = attempt.witness)) ledger.attempts = some attempt → attempt.started = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.start ledger attempt.witness = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_attempts_charged
theorems.claim: Ledger invariant of the checkpoint-scoped authority model.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_attempts_charged : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_attempts_charged
theorems.claim: One admission keeps every registered attempt cost present in the checkpoint charges.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_attempts_charged : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.evalStep_hasDerivAt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo_hasDerivAt

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo_hasDerivAt : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.WellFormed graph → ∀ (is ip ds dp : ℕ → ℝ) (count index : ℕ), index < count → HasDerivAt (fun t => NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo graph (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line is ds t) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line ip dp t) count index) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangentUpTo graph is ip ds dp count index) 0

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent_is_directional_derivative : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.WellFormed graph → ∀ (is ip ds dp : ℕ → ℝ) (index : ℕ), HasDerivAt (fun t => NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.value graph (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line is ds t) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line ip dp t) index) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent graph is ip ds dp index) 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.repeated_operand_contributes_twice
theorems.claim: A repeated operand contributes twice to its own adjoint, so accumulation adds rather than overwrites.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.repeated_operand_contributes_twice : ∀ (values adjoints : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.contribution values adjoints (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Node.mul a a) a = adjoints a * (values a + values a)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_step_adds_contribution

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_step_adds_contribution : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph) (values seed : ℕ → ℝ) (fuel operand : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed (fuel + 1) operand = NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel operand + NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.contribution values (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel) (graph.node (graph.arity - 1 - fuel)) operand

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_unchanged_when_operand_absent : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph) (values seed : ℕ → ℝ) (fuel operand : ℕ), operand ∉ (graph.node (graph.arity - 1 - fuel)).operands → NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed (fuel + 1) operand = NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel operand

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.run_emitNodes_eq

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step_computes : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (schedule : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Schedule) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (regs : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val) (index : ℕ), (∀ operand ∈ (graph.node index).operands, regs (schedule.regOf operand) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs operand) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.emitNode graph schedule index) (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule_sound
theorems.claim: After executing the remaining schedule, every already-processed node's register holds its reference value, given the order/disjointness/injectivity premises.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule_sound : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (schedule : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Schedule) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), (∀ (a b : ℕ), schedule.regOf a = schedule.regOf b → a = b) → ∀ (processed order : List ℕ) (regs : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val), (∀ index ∈ processed, index ∉ order) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.OrderOk graph processed order → order.Nodup → (∀ index ∈ processed, regs (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index) → ∀ index ∈ order ++ processed, NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule graph schedule inputs order regs (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.schedule_sound
theorems.claim: Complete ordered result equivalence: the selected output register of a validated packed schedule equals the graph reference's value for every acquired input.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.schedule_sound : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (schedule : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Schedule) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), (∀ (a b : ℕ), schedule.regOf a = schedule.regOf b → a = b) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.OrderOk graph [] schedule.order → schedule.order.Nodup → graph.output ∈ schedule.order → schedule.outReg = schedule.regOf graph.output → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.run inputs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.emitNodes graph schedule schedule.order) schedule.outReg = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs graph.output

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup_returns_recorded
theorems.claim: A witness lookup only ever yields a pair the witness recorded.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup_returns_recorded : ∀ (assign : List (ℕ × BitVec 64)) (slot : ℕ) (value : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup assign slot = some value → (slot, value) ∈ assign

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decode_uses_fallback
theorems.claim: An unrecorded slot decodes to exactly the declared fallback.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decode_uses_fallback : ∀ (assign : List (ℕ × BitVec 64)) (fallback : BitVec 64) (slot : ℕ), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup assign slot = none → NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs assign fallback slot = fallback

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decode_replays_recorded
theorems.claim: A recorded slot replays exactly its recorded bits.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decode_replays_recorded : ∀ (assign : List (ℕ × BitVec 64)) (fallback : BitVec 64) (slot : ℕ) (value : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup assign slot = some value → NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs assign fallback slot = value

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.not_refuted_iff_agrees
theorems.claim: No refutation is exactly agreement over the ordered outputs.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.not_refuted_iff_agrees : ∀ (pair : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Pair) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted pair inputs = false ↔ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn pair inputs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search_none_sound
theorems.claim: A failed search over the declared finite universe establishes agreement on that universe and nothing beyond it.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search_none_sound : ∀ (pair : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Pair) (candidates : List (ℕ → BitVec 64)), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search pair candidates = none → ∀ inputs ∈ candidates, NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn pair inputs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search_some_refutes
theorems.claim: A found candidate is a genuine refutation of the ordered results.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search_some_refutes : ∀ (pair : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Pair) (candidates : List (ℕ → BitVec 64)) (witness : ℕ → BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search pair candidates = some witness → ¬NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn pair witness

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.same_sum_search_none
theorems.claim: Two differently written faces of the same sum find no distinguishing candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.same_sum_search_none : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.search NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreePair NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.candidates = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.same_sum_agrees
theorems.claim: Consequently the same-sum pair agrees on every declared candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.same_sum_agrees : ∀ inputs ∈ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.candidates, NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreePair inputs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.subtraction_refuted
theorems.claim: The subtraction pair is genuinely refuted at one declared candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.subtraction_refuted : ¬NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.differPair fun x => 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.witness_bits_decide
theorems.claim: The exact decoded witness bits decide the verdict for the input-reading pair.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.witness_bits_decide : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 6)] 0 0 = 6 ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 6)] 0) = false ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 3)] 0) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.unrecorded_slot_falls_back
theorems.claim: A witness that omits a slot takes the declared fallback rather than acquiring bits.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.unrecorded_slot_falls_back : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 6)] 11 1 = 11 ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.lookup [(0, 6)] 1 = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.corrupted_witness_changes_the_verdict
theorems.claim: A corrupted witness can flip the verdict, so the recorded bits are load-bearing.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.corrupted_witness_changes_the_verdict : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 6)] 0) ≠ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(0, 3)] 0)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode_length
theorems.claim: The encoder records exactly one pair per declared slot.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode_length : ∀ (slots : List ℕ) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode slots inputs).length = slots.length

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.decode_encode_replays
theorems.claim: Every declared slot decodes back to the candidate's own exact bits.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.decode_encode_replays : ∀ (slots : List ℕ) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (fallback : BitVec 64), ∀ slot ∈ slots, NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode slots inputs) fallback slot = inputs slot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.corrupted_witness_shifts_bits
theorems.claim: A corrupted witness decodes to the corrupted bits and not to the candidate's.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.corrupted_witness_shifts_bits : ∀ (slot : ℕ) (value shifted fallback : BitVec 64), shifted ≠ value → NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(slot, shifted)] fallback slot = shifted ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs [(slot, shifted)] fallback slot ≠ value

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex_none_agrees
theorems.claim: A failed first-match search establishes agreement on the declared universe only.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex_none_agrees : ∀ (pair : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Pair) (candidates : List (ℕ → BitVec 64)), NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex pair candidates = none → ∀ inputs ∈ candidates, NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn pair inputs

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex_some_decomposes
theorems.claim: A reported index decomposes the universe into a non-refuting prefix of that exact length followed by a refuting candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex_some_decomposes : ∀ (pair : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.Pair) (candidates : List (ℕ → BitVec 64)) (index : ℕ), NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex pair candidates = some index → ∃ earlier candidate rest, candidates = earlier ++ candidate :: rest ∧ earlier.length = index ∧ (∀ inputs ∈ earlier, NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreesOn pair inputs) ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted pair candidate = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.same_sum_first_none
theorems.claim: The same-sum fixture pair has no refuting candidate in the declared universe.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.same_sum_first_none : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.agreePair NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.candidates = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.subtraction_first_index_zero
theorems.claim: The subtraction fixture pair is refuted at the earliest declared candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.subtraction_first_index_zero : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.differPair NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.candidates = some 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.input_first_index_zero
theorems.claim: The input-dependent fixture pair is refuted at the earliest declared candidate.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.input_first_index_zero : NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.firstIndex NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.candidates = some 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.input_zero_candidate_refutes
theorems.claim: The declared candidate at index zero really refutes the input-dependent pair.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.input_zero_candidate_refutes : (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair fun x => 0) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encoded_witness_decides
theorems.claim: Encoded witnesses replay their candidate and a corrupted one does not, on the input-dependent pair.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encoded_witness_decides : NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode [0] fun x => 6) 0) = false ∧ NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.refuted NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.inputPair (NobleFoundation.SymbolicPair.decodeInputs (NobleFoundation.SymbolicSolver.encode [0] fun x => 3) 0) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.stale_revision_refused

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.stale_revision_refused : ∀ (steps : List NobleFoundation.Certificate.Step), NobleFoundation.Certificate.wellFormed { revision := "ngraph-cert/1", steps := steps } = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.over_bound_refused

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.unordered_refused

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.unordered_refused : ∀ (first second rule₁ rule₂ : ℕ) (claimed : BitVec 64), ¬first < second → NobleFoundation.Certificate.strictlyIncreasing [{ rule := rule₁, index := first, first := 0, second := 0, firstBits := 0, secondBits := 0, claimed := claimed }, { rule := rule₂, index := second, first := 0, second := 0, firstBits := 0, secondBits := 0, claimed := claimed }] = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.unknown_rule_refused
theorems.claim: A step with an unknown rule identity cannot be accepted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.unknown_rule_refused : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (step : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Step), NobleFoundation.Certificate.decodeStep step = none → NobleFoundation.Certificate.stepAccepted graph step = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.stale_revision_kills_acceptance
theorems.claim: A stale revision kills acceptance even when every step would be accepted.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.stale_revision_kills_acceptance : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (steps : List NobleFoundation.Certificate.Step), NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted graph { revision := "ngraph-cert/1", steps := steps } = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted_implies_checked
theorems.claim: Every step of an accepted derivation has a decoded claim the graph checker accepts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted_implies_checked : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (derivation : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Derivation), NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted graph derivation = true → ∀ step ∈ derivation.steps, ∀ (claim : NobleFoundation.GraphRewrite.Claim), NobleFoundation.Certificate.decodeStep step = some claim → NobleFoundation.GraphRewrite.Checked graph claim = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted_fold_step_denotes
theorems.claim: An accepted certificate fold step denotes the claimed constant through the model own graph checker.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted_fold_step_denotes : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (derivation : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Derivation), NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted graph derivation = true → ∀ step ∈ derivation.steps, ∀ (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), step.rule = 0 → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs step.index = some (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val.i64 step.claimed)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode_encode_step_replays
theorems.claim: Decoding an encoded step whose rule identity is modelled returns the same step.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode_encode_step_replays : ∀ (step : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Step), step.rule ≤ 2 → NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decodeStep (NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeStep step) = some step

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode_encode_replays
theorems.claim: Decoding an encoded derivation returns the derivation itself for the modelled revision and rules.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode_encode_replays : ∀ (derivation : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Derivation), derivation.revision = NobleFoundation.Certificate.revision → (∀ step ∈ derivation.steps, step.rule ≤ 2) → NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode derivation.revision (NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeSteps derivation) = some derivation

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeStep_length
theorems.claim: A step occupies exactly seven tokens.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeStep_length : ∀ (step : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Step), (NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeStep step).length = 7

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.truncated_step_refused
theorems.claim: A truncated step envelope of six tokens is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.truncated_step_refused : ∀ (rule index first second firstBits secondBits : String), NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decodeStep [rule, index, first, second, firstBits, secondBits] = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.unknown_rule_token_refused

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.stale_revision_token_refused
theorems.claim: A stale revision token refuses decoding before any step is inspected.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.stale_revision_token_refused : ∀ (tokens : List (List String)) (token : String), token ≠ NobleFoundation.Certificate.revision → NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode token tokens = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.acceptance_preserved_by_codec
theorems.claim: A transport round trip preserves acceptance of a derivation.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.acceptance_preserved_by_codec : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (derivation : NobleFoundation.Certificate.Derivation), derivation.revision = NobleFoundation.Certificate.revision → (∀ step ∈ derivation.steps, step.rule ≤ 2) → Option.map (NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted graph) (NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.decode derivation.revision (NobleFoundation.CertificateCodec.encodeSteps derivation)) = some (NobleFoundation.Certificate.accepted graph derivation)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.count_inflated_refused
theorems.claim: A declared register count more than one above its registers is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.count_inflated_refused : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (index register : ℕ), layout.regs = register + 3 → layout.reg index = some register → index < graph.arity → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.countWithinOne graph layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.missing_register_refused
theorems.claim: A node declared without a register is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.missing_register_refused : ∀ (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (index : ℕ), layout.reg index = none → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.declares layout index = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.out_of_range_refused
theorems.claim: A register outside the declared count is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.out_of_range_refused : ∀ (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (index register : ℕ), layout.reg index = some register → layout.regs ≤ register → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.declares layout index = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.alias_refused
theorems.claim: Two distinct nodes that declare one register alias it and are refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.alias_refused : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (first second : ℕ), first ≠ second → layout.reg first = some 7 → layout.reg second = some 7 → first < graph.arity → second < graph.arity → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.distinctRegisters graph layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.constant_count_refused
theorems.claim: A constant table with a different entry count than the graph's constant nodes is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.constant_count_refused : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (expected : ℕ), (List.filter (fun index => match graph.node index with | NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant bits => true | x => false) (List.range graph.arity)).length = expected → layout.consts.length ≠ expected → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.constantCountOk graph layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layer_shape_refused
theorems.claim: A layer table without one range per layer is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layer_shape_refused : ∀ (layerCount : ℕ) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout), layout.layers.length ≠ layerCount → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layerShapeOk layerCount layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layers_unordered_refused
theorems.claim: A layer range that is not ordered inside itself and against its predecessor is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layers_unordered_refused : ∀ (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (start end_ previousStart previousEnd : ℕ), layout.layers = [(previousStart, previousEnd), (start, end_)] → decide (previousStart ≤ previousEnd) = true → decide (previousEnd ≤ start) = true → decide (start ≤ end_) = false → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.layerOrderOk layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.coverage_refused
theorems.claim: A layer table whose last range does not end at the instruction count is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.coverage_refused : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout) (start end_ : ℕ), layout.layers = [(start, end_)] → (List.filter (fun index => match graph.node index with | NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.input slot => false | NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node.constant bits => false | x => true) (List.range graph.arity)).length ≠ end_ → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.coverageOk graph layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.fail_suffix_mismatch_refused
theorems.claim: A declared failure-suffix table that differs from the graph's own prefix minima is refused.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.fail_suffix_mismatch_refused : ∀ (layerCount : ℕ) (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (fails : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node → Bool) (layerOf : ℕ → ℕ) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout), layout.failSuffixMin ≠ NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.expectedMinima layerCount graph fails layerOf ++ [NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.maxRegister] → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.failSuffixOk layerCount graph fails layerOf layout = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_registers
theorems.claim: An accepted layout declares a register for every node.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_registers : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layerCount : ℕ) (fails : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node → Bool) (layerOf : ℕ → ℕ) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout), NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted graph layerCount fails layerOf layout = true → ∀ index < graph.arity, NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.declares layout index = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_distinct
theorems.claim: An accepted layout never aliases a register.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_distinct : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layerCount : ℕ) (fails : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node → Bool) (layerOf : ℕ → ℕ) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout), NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted graph layerCount fails layerOf layout = true → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.distinctRegisters graph layout = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_coverage
theorems.claim: An accepted layout's last layer range ends exactly at the instruction count.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted_implies_coverage : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph) (layerCount : ℕ) (fails : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Node → Bool) (layerOf : ℕ → ℕ) (layout : NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.Layout), NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.accepted graph layerCount fails layerOf layout = true → NobleFoundation.PackedLayout.coverageOk graph layout = true
